name: FormsCN
summary: Visual shadcn/ui form builder that exports typed React + Zod (RHF or TanStack Form).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 14 registry:block form templates (excludes base-form helper + detailed-application-form).
No per-template public docs routes — all demos share /templates (and /editor, /demo/form-registry).
No top-level LICENSE file in repo; MIT asserted via packages/ui/package.json and published npm packages.
Better Auth-specific templates (2FA/passkey) not all published as public /r/*.json in this sweep.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Login Form
components.summary: Simple email and password login form for shadcn/ui.

demo.peerNotes: Requires shadcn/ui primitives; toggle RHF vs TanStack Form in builder

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://www.formscn.space/r/login-form.json

# Or open the visual builder: https://www.formscn.space/editor
# Supports React Hook Form or TanStack Form + Zod export.
# Demo registry playground: https://www.formscn.space/demo/form-registry

copyPrompt.text: Use FormsCN free MIT shadcn form template `Login Form` (slug `login-form`) from https://www.formscn.space. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.formscn.space/r/login-form.json`. Registry index: https://www.formscn.space/r/registry.json. Visual builder: https://www.formscn.space/editor. Templates gallery: https://www.formscn.space/templates. Optional runtime: `npm i @formscn/form` (MIT). Repo: https://github.com/AbdullahMukadam/formscn. License: MIT (primary: packages/ui/package.json "license":"MIT" in https://github.com/AbdullahMukadam/formscn; also npm @formscn/ui@0.1.2 and @formscn/form@0.2.0 license MIT). Pricing free.
